mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_file_session (session_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at FROM conversation_file_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_file_session SET active_file_count = active_file_count + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND active_file_count < #{limit}
UPDATE conversation_file_session SET active_file_count = active_file_count - 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND active_file_count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_file (file_id, session_id, display_name, mime_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_type, storage_key, status, created_at, removed_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{sessionId}, #{displayName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{storageType}, #{storageKey}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{removedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation_file WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, file_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_file SET status = #{status}, removed_at = #{removedAt} WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
